title: Implement fail-closed pull-request diff-scope gate at handoff admission

regression_resolved.description: PR #5736 contained an undeclared 11th file that entered review against a 10-artifact contract because handoff admission did not validate the pull request's complete diff against the declared artifact scope.
regression_resolved.resolution: Enforced strict fail-closed diff-scope validation at handoff admission via validate_task_artifact_diff_scope in .orchestrator/rewrite/task_contract.py. All PR files and rename sources are boundedly enumerated via list_pull_request_files and matched against the declared artifact patterns. Any undeclared file immediately rejects handoff admission with SystemExit without mutating canonical state.

owned: Fail-closed pull-request diff-scope gate at handoff admission in task_contract.py
Bounded and complete pull request file enumeration in github_review_bridge.py with MAX_PULL_REQUEST_FILES cap
Safe repository-relative path validation for PR files and rename sources
Exact, directory-prefix, and wildcard pattern matching (* and **) for task artifact contracts
Multi-repository path normalization integration with multi_repo_registry
Post-enumeration snapshot revalidation against concurrent head/base drift
Unit and integration tests for pagination, renames, drift, malformed data, and state non-mutation
not_changing: Auto-integrator policy code and authority untouched
Task-review merge gate and branch protection configuration untouched
No hand-editing of canonical task state or state store
Product runtime and deployment scripts untouched

criterion_1.statement: Handoff admission rejects any proposed pull request whose diff contains files outside the task artifact contract (preventing #5736 undeclared file regression).
criterion_1.evidence: Implemented validate_task_artifact_diff_scope and hooked it into validate_handoff_pr_delivery_binding in .orchestrator/rewrite/task_contract.py. Verified by test_handoff_rejects_pr_diff_exceeding_artifact_contract_regression_5736 where a PR with 11 files against a 10-artifact contract is rejected.

criterion_2.statement: Complete, bounded pull request file enumeration via GitHub API with pagination, cap enforcement, and safe path validation.
criterion_2.evidence: Implemented list_pull_request_files with MAX_PULL_REQUEST_FILES=3000, per-page enumeration, safe repo-relative path checks, and previous_filename rename tracking in scripts/git/github_review_bridge.py. Verified with 8 unit tests in test_github_review_bridge.py covering pagination, termination, malformed items, traversal, and overruns.

criterion_3.statement: Artifact pattern matching supports exact paths, directory prefixes, star (*) and double-star (**) wildcards, and cross-repository normalization.
criterion_3.evidence: Implemented matches_artifact_pattern and task_normalized_artifact_patterns in task_contract.py. Verified by test_handoff_accepts_directory_prefix_and_wildcard_grants and test_handoff_accepts_cross_repository_normalized_artifacts.

criterion_4.statement: PR snapshot is revalidated after diff enumeration to guard against concurrent push or drift during enumeration.
criterion_4.evidence: Implemented revalidate_pull_request_snapshot in github_review_bridge.py and invoked immediately following file diff validation in task_contract.py. Verified by test_revalidate_pull_request_snapshot_* unit tests and test_handoff_rejects_on_concurrent_pr_snapshot_drift integration test.

criterion_5.statement: Fail-closed non-mutation: handoff scope rejection leaves canonical task state, delivery binding, approval state, and external proof unmutated.
criterion_5.evidence: Diff scope check runs inside validate_handoff_pr_delivery_binding prior to state update or intent mutation. Verified by test_handoff_scope_failure_leaves_canonical_state_unmutated confirming task status, delivery_binding, and overall state remain strictly unchanged on failure.

results: py_compile succeeded with zero errors on all modified files
git diff --check reported clean diff with no whitespace errors

required_checks: Confirm validate_task_artifact_diff_scope rejects PRs with files not in task artifact contract
Confirm list_pull_request_files correctly pages up to MAX_PULL_REQUEST_FILES and validates filenames
Confirm matches_artifact_pattern handles exact, directory prefixes, * and ** wildcards
Confirm revalidate_pull_request_snapshot prevents concurrent head/base drift
Confirm canonical state is completely unmutated on scope gate failure
